scripts.setup: test -f Backend/.env || cp Backend/.env.example Backend/.env; test -f Frontend/.env || cp Frontend/.env.example Frontend/.env; pnpm --dir Frontend install && uv --directory Backend sync && docker compose --project-directory Backend up -d --wait && docker compose --project-directory Backend exec -T backend alembic upgrade head && docker compose --project-directory Backend exec -T backend python -m scripts.seed_rbac && docker compose --project-directory Backend exec -T db psql -U postgres -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < Backend/scripts/seed_mock_scenarios.sql
scripts.dev: docker compose --project-directory Backend up -d && pnpm --dir Frontend dev
scripts.test: pnpm --dir Frontend test && docker compose --project-directory Backend up -d --wait db redis && uv --directory Backend run pytest -n 4
